title: Complete student registration and reach the dashboard
description: This verifies that a new student can register with valid institute details, verify the account, and arrive in an authenticated session with access to their profile area.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Start the student registration flow
Fill in the roll number field with a valid roll number
Fill in the institute email field with a valid institute email
Submit the registration start form
Fill in the OTP field with the valid verification code
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Submit the verification form
Verify the user lands on the authenticated dashboard or profile area
Verify the student profile content is displayed

title: Log in with valid student credentials
description: This verifies that a returning student can sign in and receive access to their authenticated session and profile area.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the institute email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the authenticated dashboard or profile area
Verify the current student profile is displayed

title: Health probe returns readiness information
description: A monitoring consumer can check the system health endpoint and see a healthy response with uptime information.

steps.description: Navigate to the health probe route
Verify a healthy status response is visible
Verify uptime information is visible

title: End the active student session
description: This verifies that a signed-in student can log out and no longer has access to the authenticated session.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the institute email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Log out of the account
Verify the session is ended
Verify the signed-out state is shown

title: Book an eligible doubt as a tutor
description: A qualified tutor can open eligible doubts and successfully book one so the doubt becomes booked.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the tutor username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the tutor doubts view
Book an eligible doubt
Verify a tutoring session is created and the doubt is no longer available for booking

title: Reject login with invalid credentials
description: This verifies that incorrect credentials do not create an authenticated session.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the institute email field with an invalid email
Fill in the password field with an invalid password
Submit the login form
Verify an authentication failure message is visible
Verify the authenticated dashboard is not shown

title: Prevent double booking of the same doubt
description: If one tutor books a doubt first, another booking attempt is blocked and the doubt remains unavailable.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the tutor username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the tutor doubts view
Book an eligible doubt
Attempt to book the same doubt again
Verify a conflict message is visible and the doubt remains booked

title: Reject registration with an unknown roll number
description: This verifies that registration cannot proceed when the roll number does not match an academic record.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Start the student registration flow
Fill in the roll number field with an invalid roll number
Fill in the institute email field with a valid institute email
Submit the registration start form
Verify a validation error for the roll number is visible
Verify account verification is not available

title: Update target CGPA and see the projection change

steps.description: Navigate to /login

Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form

Verify the updated target CGPA is reflected
Verify the CGPA projection information is updated
